v4.6.83 — Day bot closes positions before the bell (no overnight holds)

🐛 FIXED
• The DAY bot is intraday — it now FLATTENS every open position in the last 15 minutes before the close (while the market is still open, so the sells fill immediately). Previously a day-trade could be carried overnight where no run cycle was active to enforce its stop-loss / take-profit, so a position could drift well past its stop (e.g. -12%) without selling. Now it always closes out for the day.
• Resting stop/take legs are cancelled first so the flatten isn't blocked.

Note: a day bot is not meant to hold overnight; this makes that explicit. Deployed to the cloud too, so cloud day bots flatten before the close automatically.

Update via the in-app banner.
